# 好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen, Add-on Menu and Soup Selection

Add-ons are optional and apply to every meal in every week of the rotation. Add-on prices are the same for daily customers and monthly subscribers. Add-ons are charged separately and are not included in the RM300 monthly subscription price.

## Add-on prices

### 升级糙米饭 Brown Rice Upgrade
- Price: additional RM2 per meal
- Description: replaces the standard white rice with brown rice
- Availability: every meal, every day

### 滋洞养身排骨汤 Herbal Pork Rib Soup
- Price: additional RM13 per serving
- Description: a nourishing herbal soup made with pork ribs, chosen from the weekly soup selection below
- Availability: every meal, every day
- Note: all soup varieties are pork rib based. There is no chicken or vegetarian soup option.

### 今日甜品 Today's Dessert
- Price: additional RM5 per serving
- Description: the dessert of the day, which changes daily and is not published in advance
- Availability: every meal, every day

### 养身茶 Nourishing Tea
- Price: RM13 per serving
- Description: a herbal wellness tea
- Availability: every meal, every day

## Weekly soup selection

Five herbal pork rib soups are offered on rotation. Customers who order the herbal soup add-on may choose any one of the five.

1. 淮山玉竹排骨汤, Chinese Yam and Solomon's Seal Pork Rib Soup
2. 虫草花四神排骨汤, Cordyceps Flower and Four God Herbs Pork Rib Soup
3. 莲藕花生排骨汤, Lotus Root and Peanut Pork Rib Soup
4. 党参黄芪排骨汤, Dang Shen and Astragalus Pork Rib Soup
5. 罗汉果雪梨排骨汤, Luo Han Guo and Snow Pear Pork Rib Soup

In Week 1 of the rotation, option 4 is served as 党参芡实排骨汤, Dang Shen and Gorgon Fruit Pork Rib Soup, instead of the Astragalus version.

## What is already included at no extra cost

Every main meal already includes seasonal vegetables (时蔬), a side dish (配菜) and white rice (白饭). Customers do not need to pay extra for these. The add-ons above are upgrades on top of the standard meal.
documents.business_info:
# 好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen, Business and Service Information

## Who we are

好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen is a home-style Chinese meal delivery service operating in Shah Alam and Kota Kemuning, Selangor. We cook fresh every weekday morning and deliver lunch and dinner to homes.

Our promise, as printed on every menu:
- 新鲜烹调·每日配送, freshly cooked, delivered daily
- 均衡营养·美味健康, balanced nutrition, tasty and healthy
- 真材实料·吃得安心, real ingredients, eat with peace of mind

## Contact

- **Phone and WhatsApp:** 012-345 6789
- **Enquiry hours:** 9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday
- **Weekend enquiries:** we do not answer messages on Saturday or Sunday. Messages sent over the weekend are answered on the next working day.
- **Social channels:** Facebook and Instagram

Please note that enquiry hours end at 5:00pm, which is the same time as the order cut-off. An order enquiry sent after 5:00pm will be handled the next working day and will apply to the following service day.

## How the service works

1. Check the weekly menu for the day you want
2. Place your order by 5:00pm the day before
3. Pay by online bank transfer and send the receipt
4. Your meal arrives ready to eat inside the delivery window

## The menu rotation

The menu runs on a repeating **4-week rotation**. After Week 4 the cycle returns to Week 1. Each meal within a rotation is different from the others, so a customer eating with us every day does not repeat a dish inside four weeks.

Each week offers ten meals, a lunch and a dinner for each of the five weekdays.

## Dietary scope

Please read this section before ordering if you have dietary requirements.

- **Halal:** we are **not halal certified**. Pork is cooked in the same kitchen and appears on the menu most days.
- **Pork:** pork is the most common protein on our menu. Across the 4-week rotation of 40 meals, 21 are pork dishes.
- **Chicken:** 15 of the 40 meals in the rotation are chicken dishes.
- **Fish:** 3 of the 40 meals are fish dishes. Fish is served on Wednesday dinner in rotation weeks 1, 2 and 3. Week 4 has no fish main dish. The Week 4 Thursday lunch, 咸鱼花腩煲 Claypot Pork Belly with Salted Fish, contains salted fish.
- **Beef:** we do **not** serve beef. There is no beef dish anywhere in the rotation.
- **Vegetarian:** we do **not** offer a vegetarian plan. The only tofu-led main is Stuffed Tofu on Week 4 Wednesday dinner, and it is prepared in a kitchen that handles pork and fish. Mapo Tofu on Week 3 Tuesday lunch contains minced pork despite its name.
- **Soups:** all five herbal soups are pork rib based. There is no chicken or vegetarian soup.
- **Allergens:** we publish the dish name and its main protein on the menu. We do not publish a separate allergen or nutrition breakdown. If you have a specific allergy, contact us before ordering and we will tell you what is in that day's dish.

We cannot substitute a dish, swap a protein or prepare a separate meal to order. The menu is fixed for all customers on a given day.

## Service summary

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| Service area | Shah Alam, Kota Kemuning |
| Delivery fee | Free |
| Service days | Monday to Friday |
| Lunch window | 11:30am to 1:00pm |
| Dinner window | 5:00pm to 6:30pm |
| Order cut-off | 5:00pm the day before |
| Plans | Daily, Monthly |
| Daily price | RM15 or RM18 per meal, as printed on the weekly menu |
| Monthly price | RM300 for 20 meals of one service |
| Payment | Online bank transfer only |
| Refunds | Not offered |

# 好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen, Delivery Policy

## Delivery areas

Delivery is available in two areas only:

- Shah Alam
- Kota Kemuning

Delivery to both areas is **free of charge**. There is no minimum order value and no delivery fee.

We do not deliver outside Shah Alam and Kota Kemuning. This includes nearby areas such as Klang, Subang Jaya, Puchong, Petaling Jaya, Bukit Jelutong, Cyberjaya and Kuala Lumpur. We do not offer paid delivery, self-collection or third party courier to addresses outside the two service areas. Customers outside the coverage area cannot be served at this time.

## Delivery windows

- **Lunch:** 11:30am to 1:00pm
- **Dinner:** 5:00pm to 6:30pm

Meals are delivered within the stated window. We cannot guarantee an exact arrival time inside the window, as the delivery order depends on the route for that day.

## Service days

Delivery runs Monday to Friday only.

There is no delivery on Saturday or Sunday. There is no delivery on public holidays. See the holiday notice document for the specific dates affected.

## Order cut-off

Orders must be placed **by 5:00pm on the day before delivery**.

Examples:
- To receive lunch on Wednesday, order by 5:00pm on Tuesday.
- To receive dinner on Wednesday, order by 5:00pm on Tuesday.
- To receive a meal on Monday, order by 5:00pm on the previous Friday, since we are closed on the weekend.

Orders placed after the cut-off will be scheduled for the next available service day. We cannot accept same day orders, because meals are cooked fresh to the confirmed order count each morning.

## Changes and cancellations

Any change or cancellation to an order must also reach us before the 5:00pm cut-off on the day before delivery. After the cut-off the meal has been counted into the cooking plan and cannot be changed or cancelled. See the payment and refund policy for what happens to a meal cancelled after cut-off.

## Meal condition on arrival

Meals are delivered ready to eat. No reheating or further preparation is required. We recommend eating the meal shortly after it arrives for the best taste and texture.

# 好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen, Frequently Asked Questions

These are the questions customers ask most often on WhatsApp. Where a question involves money, dates or terms, the linked policy document is the authority.

## Ordering

**Q: How do I order?**
Send us a WhatsApp message on 012-345 6789 with the date, the service you want (lunch, dinner or both) and any add-ons. We confirm and send bank details. See business_info.

**Q: What time must I order by?**
By 5:00pm on the day before delivery. See delivery_policy.

**Q: Can I order for today?**
No. We cook to the confirmed order count each morning, so same day orders are not possible. Your order will go to the next service day. See delivery_policy.

**Q: I want a meal on Monday. When do I order?**
By 5:00pm the previous Friday, since we are closed on the weekend. See delivery_policy.

**Q: Can I change or cancel my order?**
Yes, if you tell us before 5:00pm on the day before. After the cut-off the meal is already counted into the cooking plan and cannot be changed. See payment_and_refund_policy.

**Q: Is there a minimum order?**
No. You can order a single meal on the daily plan. See delivery_policy.

## Delivery

**Q: Do you deliver to Shah Alam?**
Yes, and delivery is free. See delivery_policy.

**Q: Do you deliver to Kota Kemuning?**
Yes, and delivery is free. See delivery_policy.

**Q: Do you deliver to Klang, Subang, Puchong, PJ or KL?**
No. We serve Shah Alam and Kota Kemuning only. We do not offer paid delivery or self-collection outside these two areas. See delivery_policy.

**Q: How much is delivery?**
Free within our two service areas. There is no delivery fee and no minimum order.

**Q: What time will my food arrive?**
Lunch between 11:30am and 1:00pm. Dinner between 5:00pm and 6:30pm. We cannot promise an exact time inside the window. See delivery_policy.

**Q: Do you deliver on weekends?**
No. We deliver Monday to Friday only.

**Q: Do you deliver on public holidays?**
No. See holiday_notice_2026 for the specific dates.

## Menu and food

**Q: What is today's lunch?**
Check the menu for the current rotation week. The menu runs on a repeating 4-week cycle, so any date maps to one of the four weekly menus. See menu_week_1 through menu_week_4.

**Q: Can I choose my own dish?**
No. One lunch dish and one dinner dish are served each day, the same for every customer. The subscription is for convenience, not for menu choice. See subscription_guide.

**Q: What comes with the meal?**
Seasonal vegetables, a side dish and white rice, all included in the price. See addons_and_soups.

**Q: Do I need to reheat the food?**
No. Meals arrive ready to eat. We suggest eating soon after delivery for the best taste.

**Q: How much is brown rice?**
An extra RM2 per meal. See addons_and_soups.

**Q: How much is the soup?**
The herbal pork rib soup is an extra RM13 per serving, and you may pick any of the five varieties. See addons_and_soups.

**Q: How much is dessert?**
An extra RM5 per serving. The dessert changes daily and is not published in advance.

**Q: Do you have halal food?**
No. We are not halal certified, and pork is cooked in the same kitchen. See business_info.

**Q: Do you serve beef?**
No. There is no beef dish anywhere in the menu rotation. See business_info.

**Q: Which meals have no pork?**
Chicken, fish and tofu dishes are marked on each weekly menu with a protein icon. Across the 4-week rotation, 15 meals are chicken, 3 are fish and 1 is tofu. Note that Mapo Tofu contains minced pork, and Claypot Pork Belly with Salted Fish contains both pork and fish. See business_info.

**Q: Do you have a vegetarian option?**
No. We do not offer a vegetarian plan, and the one tofu-led main is prepared in a kitchen that handles pork and fish. See business_info.

**Q: Which meals contain chicken?**
Chicken dishes are marked with a chicken icon on each weekly menu. See menu_week_1 through menu_week_4.

**Q: Show me the fish dishes.**
Fish is served on Wednesday dinner in rotation weeks 1, 2 and 3. Week 4 has no fish main dish, though the Thursday lunch claypot contains salted fish. See the individual weekly menus.

**Q: Can you leave out an ingredient or swap the protein?**
No. The menu is fixed for all customers on a given day and we cannot prepare a separate meal to order. See business_info.

**Q: Do you publish calories or allergens?**
No. We publish the dish name and its main protein. If you have a specific allergy, contact us before ordering and we will tell you what is in that day's dish.

## Plans and pricing

**Q: How much is one meal?**
RM15 or RM18 depending on the meal if you order day by day, as printed on the weekly menu. RM15 on every meal if you are on the monthly plan. See subscription_guide.

**Q: Why are some meals RM18?**
The RM18 meals are usually the claypot or slow-braised dishes, most often on Wednesday and Thursday. The weekly menu prints the price of every meal, so check the menu for the day you want. Daily customers pay the printed price. Monthly subscribers pay RM15 for every meal. See subscription_guide.

**Q: Why is my friend paying RM15 for the claypot chicken and I am paying RM18?**
Your friend is on the monthly plan, which is priced at a flat RM15 per meal, including the meals priced RM18 on the daily plan. You are ordering day by day. See subscription_guide.

**Q: How much is the monthly plan?**
RM300 for 20 weekday meals of one service. Lunch only is RM300, dinner only is RM300, both is RM600. See subscription_guide.

**Q: Can I subscribe for lunch only?**
Yes. Lunch only, dinner only, or both. See subscription_guide.

**Q: Is there a weekly plan?**
No. We offer the daily plan and the monthly plan only. See subscription_guide.

**Q: Can I start the monthly plan in the middle of the month?**
Yes. Your cycle starts on whatever date you choose and runs for 20 weekday meals from there. Subscribers start on many different dates. See subscription_guide.

**Q: When does my monthly cycle end?**
It depends on your start date and on how many public holidays and cancelled meals fall inside your cycle, since each one extends the cycle by a service day. Ask us and we will check your record. See subscription_guide.

**Q: How many meals do I have left?**
Ask us and we will check your record.

**Q: Do weekends use up my 20 meals?**
No. Your 20 meals are weekday meals only. Saturday and Sunday are never counted. See subscription_guide.

**Q: What happens to my meals on a public holiday?**
Nothing is deducted. Your cycle extends by one service day for each holiday. See holiday_notice_2026.

## Payment and refunds

**Q: How do I pay?**
Online bank transfer only. We do not take cash, card or e-wallet. See payment_and_refund_policy.

**Q: Can I pay cash on delivery?**
No. Online transfer only.

**Q: When do I pay?**
Daily plan customers pay when the order is confirmed. Monthly subscribers pay the full cycle before it begins. See payment_and_refund_policy.

**Q: Can I get a refund?**
No. We do not offer refunds in any situation. See payment_and_refund_policy.

**Q: Can I pause my subscription?**
There is no formal pause. Cancel the affected meals before 5:00pm the day before, and each one is not deducted and extends your cycle by a service day. That gives the same result as a pause. Meals not cancelled in time are deducted and are not refunded. See payment_and_refund_policy.

**Q: I was away for a week and did not tell you. Can I get those meals back?**
No. Meals not cancelled before the cut-off are counted as delivered. See payment_and_refund_policy.

## Contact

**Q: What are your enquiry hours?**
9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday. Weekend messages are answered on the next working day. See business_info.

**Q: How do I reach you?**
Phone or WhatsApp on 012-345 6789, or through our Facebook and Instagram pages.
documents.holiday_notice_2026:
# 好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen, Public Holiday Service Notice

**This notice overrides the standard delivery schedule for the dates listed below.** On these dates the normal Monday to Friday service does not run, and the normal lunch and dinner delivery windows do not apply.

## Closure dates

### Monday 31 August 2026, Merdeka Day (Hari Kebangsaan)
- No lunch delivery
- No dinner delivery
- The kitchen is closed
- Service resumes as normal on Tuesday 1 September 2026

### Wednesday 16 September 2026, Malaysia Day (Hari Malaysia)
- No lunch delivery
- No dinner delivery
- The kitchen is closed
- Service resumes as normal on Thursday 17 September 2026

## Effect on monthly subscribers

Public holidays are **not deducted** from your 20 meal balance. For each closure date that falls inside your cycle, your cycle is **extended by one service day**.

Worked example. A subscriber on the lunch monthly plan starts on Monday 24 August 2026. Without any holiday, 20 weekday meals would end on Friday 18 September 2026. Two public holidays fall inside that span, Merdeka Day on 31 August and Malaysia Day on 16 September, so no meals are delivered on those two days and none are deducted. The cycle extends by two service days and ends on Tuesday 22 September 2026 instead.

Because subscribers start on different dates, the number of holidays inside each cycle differs. Ask us and we will confirm your own adjusted end date.

## Effect on daily customers

There is nothing to adjust. Simply do not place an order for a closure date. Any order mistakenly placed for a closure date is held as credit against your next order.

## Order cut-off around a closure

The 5:00pm cut-off still applies, and it counts service days, not calendar days. To receive lunch on Tuesday 1 September 2026, the day after Merdeka Day, order by 5:00pm on Friday 28 August 2026, because Saturday, Sunday and Merdeka Day are all non-service days.

## Dates still to be confirmed

Maulidur Rasul falls on a lunar date and the 2026 date has not yet been confirmed against the official Selangor gazette. If it lands on a weekday service day, a further notice will be issued and the same extension rule will apply.

# 好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen, Payment and Refund Policy

## Accepted payment method

**Online bank transfer only.**

We do not accept cash on delivery, credit card, debit card, e-wallet, cheque or any payment app. Please transfer to the account details we provide when your order is confirmed, and send us the transfer receipt.

## When payment is due

- **Daily plan:** pay per use. Payment is due when the order is confirmed, before the 5:00pm cut-off on the day before delivery.
- **Monthly plan:** the full RM300 for the cycle, or RM600 if you take both lunch and dinner, is paid before the cycle begins.

Add-ons are charged on top and are paid with the order they belong to.

An order is only confirmed once payment is received. An unpaid order is not counted into the cooking plan and will not be delivered.

## Refund policy

**We do not offer refunds.**

This applies to all situations, including:

- A meal you no longer want after the 5:00pm cut-off
- Days you were away, unwell or travelling during a monthly cycle
- Meals left unused at the end of a monthly cycle
- A monthly cycle you wish to stop partway through

Once the cut-off has passed, ingredients for your meal have been bought and the meal has been counted into the cooking plan, so the cost cannot be recovered.

## Cancellation before cut-off

A cancellation received **before 5:00pm on the day before delivery** is free of charge. For daily customers, the payment is held as credit against your next order. For monthly subscribers, the meal is not deducted from your 20 meals and your cycle extends by one service day, exactly as it does for a public holiday.

A cancellation received **after the cut-off** is not possible. The meal is counted as delivered and is deducted from your monthly meal balance.

## Pausing a monthly cycle

There is no formal pause facility. If you know in advance that you will be away, cancel the affected meals before the 5:00pm cut-off for each day. Each meal cancelled in time is not deducted, and your cycle extends by one service day for each cancelled meal. This achieves the same result as a pause.

Cancellations that miss the cut-off cannot be recovered and are not refunded.

## Unused meals at the end of a cycle

A monthly cycle is 20 service days of meals. Because cancelled and holiday days extend the cycle rather than expiring, meals are not normally lost. Any balance remaining when you choose to stop is not refunded and does not carry into a new cycle.
documents.subscription_guide:
# 好吃厨房 Tasty Kitchen, Subscription Guide

We offer two plans only: the **daily plan** and the **monthly plan**. There is no weekly plan.

Both plans deliver the same food from the same weekly menu. The menu is fixed and the same for every customer on a given day. Customers do not choose their dish. The subscription is a convenience arrangement, not a menu choice: it saves you from ordering every day, and on the monthly plan it also saves you money on the RM18 meals.

## Daily plan

Order meal by meal, as often or as rarely as you like.

- Order any number of days: one day, three days, twelve days, or any pattern that suits you
- Choose lunch only, dinner only, or both
- Price: **RM15** or **RM18** per meal, as printed on the weekly menu
- The RM18 meals are usually the Wednesday and Thursday claypot or slow-braised dishes. The weekly menu prints the price of every meal
- Pay per use. Pay for the meals you order, when you order them
- No commitment, no minimum, no lock-in

## Monthly plan

A block of **20 weekday meals** for one service, starting on the date you choose.

- Price: **RM300** for 20 meals of one service, which works out to RM15 per meal
- Lunch only: RM300 per cycle
- Dinner only: RM300 per cycle
- Both lunch and dinner: RM600 per cycle, which is 20 lunches plus 20 dinners
- Your cycle starts on your own start date. It does not have to be the first of the month. Subscribers start on many different dates
- Your cycle runs for 20 weekday service days from your start date, then ends

### The saving on RM18 meals

On the monthly plan, **every meal costs RM15, including the meals priced RM18 on the daily plan**. A daily customer pays RM18 for a Thursday claypot chicken. A monthly subscriber pays RM15 for the same meal. This is the main financial benefit of the monthly plan.

Across a typical 20 meal cycle the rotation contains several RM18 meals, so a monthly subscriber pays RM300 for meals that would cost more than RM300 if bought day by day.

### Weekends and public holidays

Your 20 meals are weekday meals only. Saturday and Sunday are not service days and are never counted against your 20 meals.

**Public holidays are not counted against your 20 meals either.** When a public holiday falls inside your cycle, there is no delivery that day and your cycle is **extended by one service day** so that you still receive all 20 meals you paid for.

Example: a subscriber starts on Monday 24 August 2026 on the lunch plan. Merdeka Day falls on Monday 31 August 2026, a normal service day. There is no delivery on 31 August, no meal is deducted, and the cycle simply runs one weekday longer at the end.

Because start dates differ and holidays fall in different places in each cycle, subscribers finish on many different dates. Two people who started on the same day finish together, but anyone starting a day apart, or crossing a different number of holidays, ends on a different date. If you want to know your own cycle end date or how many meals you have left, ask us and we will check your record.

A subscriber on both lunch and dinner receives 40 meals in a cycle, 20 lunches and 20 dinners across the same 20 service days, for RM600.

## What both plans include

Every meal on both plans includes seasonal vegetables, a side dish and white rice. Add-ons such as brown rice, herbal soup, dessert and tea are charged separately at the prices in the add-on menu, on both plans.

## Changing between plans

You may move from the daily plan to the monthly plan at any time by starting a new monthly cycle. A monthly cycle in progress runs to its end; we do not convert a partly used monthly cycle back into daily credit.
